facts.fact: IWMI states that the Mali Drought Monitoring System, built on WaPOR satellite data and co-developed with the Ministry of Agriculture's National Directorate of Agriculture, is in beta under stakeholder review, to be hosted by CPS/SDR and operated by the directorate once validated.
